messages:
Rae (AE): Quick POC sync for Cobalt Bank. Top asks: delegated subdomain verification, SCIM link-only for regulated units, SAML attributes, per-namespace RBAC, and single invoice with per-namespace metering. Short replies pls. :wave:
Luca (Cobalt IT): Hi corporate wants one contract but each legal unit must control its own subdomain and admins. SCIM should not create accounts for everyone. Link-only preferred.
Omar (SE): TL;DR bullets: 1) delegated DNS TXT per-subdomain (no DNS creds). Example `_rdw-sub=chk_3a9d`. Verify with `dig TXT _rdw-sub.ops.cobalt.bank`. 2) SCIM: support link-only and create-on-provision; can enforce server-side whitelist. 3) SAML: recommended attrs: NameID (email), givenName, familyName, groups.
Hana (Security): Confirm we don't persist full SAML assertions and whether `last_login` can be disabled. Also need to confirm KMS options for Private.
Omar (SE): We do not persist raw assertions by default; we log auth events. `last_login` can be disabled on Dedicated/Private; hosted requires add-on. Private supports customer-managed KMS/HSM.
Luca (Cobalt IT): For SCIM, we want only three groups to provision: infra-ops, app-admins, compliance. Can you enforce both IdP filter and server-side whitelist?
Omar (SE): Yes  recommend IdP filter + we enforce a whitelist. We'll provide an Okta/AD sample. For POC we'll enable whitelist + link-only mode.
billing-bot: Single contract OK. Reserved-capacity discounts apply at contract level; we can show per-namespace consumption and allocate credits. Finance needs steady tokens/day and peak rps.
Rae (AE): Action items: Omar  send SAML SP metadata + DNS TXT example + SCIM whitelist sample + curl test; Hana  produce 1-page security FAQ (KMS, HSM, TLS, retention); billing-bot  send forecasting template. POC kickoff scheduled Tue 08:30 UTC.
Luca (Cobalt IT): One compliance ask: can domain verification be delegated to a subdomain admin without exposing billing or repo access?
Omar (SE): Yes  domain tokens are issued per-namespace; verification is a public TXT check only. No credentials required and no billing access needed to verify. We can produce a signed attestation saying we never request DNS creds.
Luca (Cobalt IT): Can you provide a tiny SCIM link-only curl so our IdP team can test?
Omar (SE): Sample (link-only; will 404 if user doesn't exist):
```bash
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <PROV_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users \
  -d '{"userName":"maria.ops@sub.cobalt.bank","emails":[{"value":"maria.ops@sub.cobalt.bank"}],"externalId":"ext-200"}'
```
Hana (Security): Note: retention defaults differ by deployment. Hosted: short retention default, long retention add-on. Dedicated/Private: per-namespace configurable. I'll include retention options in the FAQ and whether `last_login` is stored.
Rae (AE): Great. I'll bundle artifacts and send to Luca after Hana and Omar's docs land. Anything else?
Luca (Cobalt IT): One more  procurement wants to know if seat discounts can be applied per-sub under single reserved contract.
billing-bot: Yes. Discounts applied at contract level; we can apply pro-rata credits per namespace. Provide forecast and finance will prepare a quote.
Rae (AE): Perfect thanks team  will follow up with the prep packet. :thumbsup;
